title: Effectiveness of Hidden-State Probes for Localizing Reasoning Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.22046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Verifying the final answer of a long reasoning trace may show that the trace is wrong but it does not distinguish three cases. The problem may lie beyond the model's capability, another attempt would succeed, or one step in an otherwise recoverable trace made the trace fail. Standard hidden-state probes are trained on final-answer correctness, a label that conflates these cases. Monte Carlo rollouts distinguish the cases and locate the failing step at additional inference cost. We test the hidden states of 4B and 8B reasoning models for the failure type and the failing step and compare each probe with the strongest baseline that uses no hidden states. On incorrect 8B traces, the confidence probe, a calibrated correctness probe at a midpoint cutoff, misses 81% of cases in which a single step makes the trace unrecoverable and 47% of cases in which another attempt would succeed. A probe with a different training design over the same state

translated_title: 隐状态探针在定位推理失败方面的有效性
translated_abstract: 验证长推理轨迹的最终答案可以表明该轨迹是错误的，但无法区分三种情况：问题可能超出了模型的能力范围、再次尝试可能会成功，或者在一个原本可恢复的轨迹中某一步骤导致轨迹失败。标准的隐状态探针是基于最终答案正确性来训练的，而这一标签混淆了上述几种情况。蒙特卡洛展开可以区分这些情况并定位失败的步骤，但需要额外的推理成本。我们测试了4B和8B推理模型的隐状态，用于判断失败类型和失败步骤，并将每个探针与不使用隐状态的最强基线进行比较。在8B模型的错误轨迹上，置信度探针（一种在中点截断处经过校准的正确性探针）错过了81%的由单一步骤导致轨迹不可恢复的情况，以及47%的再次尝试可能会成功的情况。一种在同一状态上采用不同训练设计的探针……
tldr: 该研究发现基于最终答案正确性训练的隐状态探针难以有效区分推理失败的具体类型，例如置信度探针在检测单步致命错误和可重试成功的情况时分别漏掉了81%和47%的案例。
en_tdlr: Hidden-state probes trained on final-answer correctness fail to effectively distinguish reasoning failure types, with confidence probes missing 81% of single-step fatal errors and 47% of recoverable-by-retry cases on 8B model traces.
